name: yui_aux_0001
statement: ∀ z : ℝ≥0∞, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → z ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ε)) → z = 0
proof:
intro z hz
apply le_antisymm _ zero_le
apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add
intro ε hε _
have hεreal : (0 : ℝ) < (ε : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hε
have hhalf : 0 < (ε : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
have hconvert : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ((ε : ℝ) / 2)) = (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  rw [show 2 * ((ε : ℝ) / 2) = (ε : ℝ) by ring]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal
simpa only [zero_add, hconvert] using hz ((ε : ℝ) / 2) hhalf

name: yui_aux_0002
statement: ∀ (X : Type u) [MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (s δ : ℝ) (V : ℕ → Set X), A ⊆ ⋃ i, V i → (∀ i, Metric.ediam (V i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) → (⨅ (U : ℕ → Set X) (_ : A ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) (_ : ∀ i, Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ), ∑' i, Metric.ediam (U i) ^ s) ≤ ∑' i, Metric.ediam (V i) ^ s
proof:
intro X instX A s δ V hcov hdiam
apply iInf_le_of_le V
apply iInf_le_of_le hcov
apply iInf_le_of_le hdiam
exact le_rfl
